Name: Em's Rabbit's Foot
Author: Rivalrabbit
Description:
Four options for the Rabbit's Foot for Content Patcher
Two original remakes of the rabbit's foot and two fewer '[i]limp missing[/i]' options
All items remain obtained and used in the same way; they only look and are named differently[i]
[/i]
The four options are:
A rabbit's foot with wood
A rabbit's foot with gold
A rabbit carrot snack
A golden carrot trinket

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/rwdXkjZL/Foot.png[/img]
﻿
A remake of the original Rabbit's Foot. Some say it's lucky. But make sure to keep an eye out. Either a bun in your coop is limping, or there is a little villain among them!

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/QMsmdkPK/Snack.png[/img]

When a rabbit enjoys your company, they might leave a Snack out for you. A shared snack that is. Although left with care, they couldn't resist a bite.

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/mrwwz1fX/Trinket.png[/img]﻿

A shiny golden Rabbit Trinket. It is believed that these are gifted by the warren to those caring well for them. I wonder if someone lost a tooth over that bite, though.

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/W1HQ4bKW/CP.png[/img]

Download and install the latest [url=https://smapi.io///]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher
[/url]Download and unzip "Em's Rabbit Items"
Move the folder to \Stardew Valley\Mods\
Enjoy!

The default is set to the Rabbit's Foot with a golden ring. To choose a different type:
Open the [i]config.json[/i] file in the Rabbit Item mod folder
Replace "[color=#e69138]RabbitGold[/color]" with "[color=#e69138]RabbitWood[/color]",  "[color=#e69138]Carrot[/color]", or "[color=#e69138]Golden[/color]"
Save and close the folder again, and you're all set!

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/MGb2cDyd/Patchnotes.png[/img]
